author: Joanna Wilson
text: I get that 10 min warning a lot too. Just leave it and rescan and usually it’s all good 🙂it can happen if you move out of range, like if I walk into another room, it needs time to reconnect itself.

author: Barrie Linch
text: Yes, don't be so quick to remove them. It may well be worth persevering.

author: Helen Grice
text: Lot of them are perfectly OK after a few 10 min warnings

author: Lynn Haugen
text: If you are using the app on your phone, you may need to restart your phone or delete and reinstall the app.
